name: jessee-extension
description: Chrome and Safari extension that turns screen walkthroughs into structured AI-ready documents.

scripts.build:safari: npm run safari:resources && xcodebuild -project safari/JesSee.xcodeproj -scheme JesSee -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath safari/build build
scripts.build:safari:unsigned: npm run safari:resources && xcodebuild -project safari/JesSee.xcodeproj -scheme JesSee -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath safari/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages dev ./site-dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch main
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch codex-safari-web-extension
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
